activity.overview: Split the pieces of a model into smaller equal pieces to find equivalent fractions.

problems.prompt: Draw a strip and shade 1/2 of it. Now split each part into 3 equal parts. How many parts are there now? How many are shaded? Write the equivalent fraction.
Draw a rectangle split into 4 equal parts and shade 3 of them. Then split each part in half. What fraction of the rectangle is shaded now?
Fill in the blank: 2/3 = ?/12. What number did you multiply the numerator and the denominator by?
Explain why 1/4 = 3/12. Use the idea that the pieces get smaller but there are more of them.
Is 2/6 equivalent to 1/3? Show how you know with a model or with multiplication.

activity.subject: mathematics
activity.title: Modeling Equivalent Fractions
